fee.side_note: Buying YES executes at basis_yes_ask; buying NO executes at basis_no_ask. Each fee is computed from its own side's quoted ask -- the NO figure is never derived as 1 - yes_ask, because that complement is not a price anyone is offering. A null figure means that side had no quoted ask, not that it is free.
